Brightport_dominio1.m: Our tribe was taught the ways many years ago by the honorable paladins of Nor City. We were given the Holy Book of Rites, which I relentlessly study to enlighten my people.
r: Finally someone who can speak properly, can you tell me more?

brightport_dominio0.m: You returned the bones of our people back to us. Shadow be with you, human.
r: The chieftain told me, you have a task for me.
Why is a Shadow priest in this place?

brightport_dominio10.m: Good, the specific phrase you must chant is "Kazaul thu'um kha'zan". After that deliver a solid blow to these crystals, then report back to me if this truly works. May the Shadow watch over you.

brightport_dominio11.m: The Shadow welcomes you, outsider. How is the task?
r: I found those crystals and shattered them.
What am I supposed to do again?
It might be too tough for me now, I'll attempt it again later.

brightport_dominio12.m: Remember, find the two crystals inside the ruins to the west, and try to break them.

brightport_dominio13.m: Great, and what about the beasts?
r: Once the crystals were shattered, they dissipated.

brightport_dominio14.m: That is wonderful news! Please tell the chief about your deeds. I shall pray the Shadow guide one as brave as you.

r: How did the Shadow end up in a place like this?
Can you tell more about the lizard people?

brightport_dominio16.m: When the honorable people of Nor City arrived here and requested our assistance in battle, we obliged under the condition that they cleanse the ruins of the beasts. While the warriors were away, I was taught of the Shadow by the priests of the group, and oh what wonder the Shadow is... It speaks to me in my dreams!

brightport_dominio17.m: The expression on the lizardman's face is indecipherable, but you can tell its eyes dazed off into space.

brightport_dominio18.m: We posses a long oral tradition dating back to the last lizardman empire, but it does not tell us of our origins before that. Of the arrival.

brightport_dominio19.m: Our earliest history begins with the Silverscales. Before the tribes split, we were one, with scales that glimmered silver, some shining as bright as light.

brightport_dominio2.m: I see you are longing for the wisdom of the Shadow, but you have been sent to me with a purpose, is that not the case?
r: The chieftain told me you have a task for me.

brightport_dominio20.m: We did not live in swamps or damp caves, our homes were in the lakes. The Silverscales were advanced in culture and architecture. Before long, they called themselves an empire, one that lasted hundreds of years, but it was not eternal.

brightport_dominio21.m: A calamity brought them down. The stories tell of demons. Proficient in dark arts and lustful for blood. We fought but the enemy was not one we could defeat. Here our records vanish, yet any lizardman can tell, we endured, and came back. We emerged back to the surface but we were different, no longer possessing the otherwordly glimmer. Our technology regressed. Try as we may, the knowledge was lost.
r: If the knowledge was lost how come you still know of the silverscales?

brightport_dominio22.m: The Silverscales history is carved on murals deep within the last city, in which the yellow scales make their home. We often make pilgrimages to the spire of our forebears to commune with the elders, and each tribe possesses artifacts from their time.

brightport_dominio23.m: From here on, history is better known, we lived in other places, and across the land different tribes thrived. But none more so than the tribes of the bright lake, here it was where the legacy of the forefathers remained. Yet we did not evolve, but stagnate.

brightport_dominio24.m: Men without scales; humans. They came and built. The more proud and warlike tribes fought them, and the humans retaliated. Where one tribe wars, the others come to aid. And we were shattered and dispersed, our claws could not match the swords. Each generation split apart the tribes further and further.
r: Is that why you're a different color than the lizardmen outside?

brightport_dominio25.m: The wisdom of the elders says that the scales are a reflection of one's spirit, the warlike turned red and the wise green. That the redscales have come back to the lake is no surprise, I've witnessed the conflict between humans, it left them weak.
r: I see, thanks for telling me this story.

brightport_dominio26.m: The diadem you received from our chieftain is one of them. Long gone, only the pinnacle of their craftsmanship remains, a worthy reward indeed.

brightport_dominio26_alt.m: We can speak about it later. Chief Elyzard might have one for you once you inform him of your success.

brightport_dominio27.m: I sense another on you, a necklace we gifted to the leader of the Nor City warriors who had been here. The man, named Lutarc, asked for our help in battle against his enemies, and that day he fell on the battlefield.
r: He seemed to be doing alright, can't help but think compared to the diadem this necklace is on the weaker side.

brightport_dominio28.m: What constitutes an artifact is its immunity to decay. Created thousands of years ago, only the magical remain. The necklace's properties seem to attract scaled creatures lesser in nature, but that is all I can tell.
r: I see, thanks for telling me this story.

brightport_dominio3.m: I don't trust you. outsider. Leave.

brightport_dominio4.m: Yes. But outsider, this is no mere task. Every man who has sought to prove themselves to our tribe has been tasked with this challenge, but none have succeeded.

brightport_dominio5.m: In the caves close to here lies the entrance to a ruin from which at times beasts of darkness emerge to attack our village.

brightport_dominio6.m: We have driven them back numerous times, but past the entrance no lizardman can pass; a force holds us back. The only ones able to pass are humans.

brightport_dominio7.m: Over hundreds of years, adventurers have failed to slay the beast, or claimed to have done so but the attacks continued, leaving us to distrust your brethren.

brightport_dominio8.m: The last human to challenge the ruin was a man named Lutarc. He slayed the beasts and brought back two stone tablets, which shone light on the origin of those creatures. They are not mere monsters, but guardians that will manifest as long as the magic maintaining the millennia old ruins is still active.

brightport_dominio9.m: The source of that lies in two crystals within the ruins. From the two tablets I discovered that the key is chanting a specific phrase before them. We need a human like you to undertake the last step to secure our sanctuary.

brightport_lizard.1: In the rundown mysterious basement behind Bryma's house, I encountered a humanoid green creature that fled beyond a pile of cave rubble.
brightport_lizard.5: When I questioned Bryma about the creature, she explained that lizardmen live in the caves beneath her house and have been bothering her for some time.
brightport_lizard.10: I agreed to help Bryma with her problem. She shared the activation phrase for another statue leading deeper into the forest.
brightport_lizard.15: After navigating through the caves, I reached an open chamber beyond the rubble, where I found the lizardman again.
brightport_lizard.20: The lizardman regarded me suspiciously, calling me an intruder. He claimed Bryma had been stealing bones from their ancestral tomb, which his people were trying to recover.
brightport_lizard.25: I attacked the lizardman, but my attack merely grazed it, before it fled deeper into the caves.
brightport_lizard.30: I tried to calm Emyro's worries. He hesitated but told me to visit their leader before disappearing into the shadows.
brightport_lizard.32: I tracked down and killed the lizardmen's leader, Elyzard.
brightport_lizard.35: I killed the rest of those slimy lizards. Bryma can now rest free.
brightport_lizard.36: I received a reward from Bryma for getting rid of the creatures.
brightport_lizard.40: To earn the trust of the tribe's leader, Elyzard. I swore to return the 13 stolen bones.
brightport_lizard.50: To my astonishment, I discovered that Bryma had ground the bones into dust for her research and fertilizer experiments.
brightport_lizard.55: Bryma suggested I retrieve replacement bones from other sources. She advised hunting the hostile red lizardmen in the nearby area until I could gather the required amount.
brightport_lizard.60: I delivered the bones to Elyzard, who acknowledged my effort but requested one more task. He instructed me to visit the Shadow Chaplain's cave for further guidance.
brightport_lizard.65: From Dominio, the Shadow chaplain, I learned that beasts of darkness were attacking the tribe from an ancient ruin on the western side of the cave.
brightport_lizard.70: To stop the attacks, I was tasked with destroying two crystals within the ruins by chanting the phrase "Kazaul thu'um kha'zan" before striking them.
brightport_lizard.90: Elyzard recognized my effort, and rewarded me with a trinbal artifact.
brightport_lizard.95: I offered the lizardmen a deal of cooperation to supply Bryma with animal bones as a sign of mutual respect.
brightport_lizard.100: Bryma agreed to stop intruding on the lizardmen's tomb, as they promised to supply her with bones for her research.
brightport_lizard.110: Bryma agreed to stop intruding on the lizardmen's tomb.
